name: Tune Advisor Apply
rationale:
The Tune Advisor's Save writes its suggested changes to the FC. Pins
what reaches the FC: only the advised fields change, and nothing is
written unless every read is complete (a short reply would decode as a
tune of zeros), the FC still holds the tune the flights were flown on
(same values and profiles) and the model is disarmed; a failed write is
never committed to EEPROM; F is never applied without its rates (a
percentage-only rates_type applies neither); advice that would leave a
setting's range is not offered; a full-stick rate cut is one 20% step;
P is raised at most 50% above the pilot's own P (from changes.csv);
each stage is shown; a shaking axis that gets no P step still names the shake in its reasons (issue #2643); advice refreshes when the PID profile changes on the same aircraft. Issues #2639, #2640 and #2642: with polar cyclic on, roll gets no rate or F advice; a cyclic ring below 100% caps the rate asked at full stick; an axis that I-term relax does not act on gets no cut-off advice; and Apply refuses a flight whose Cyclic polarity, ring or I-term relax type differs from the FC.
